title: ConversationControl
description: The answer to POST /api/v1/discussions/{crew}/{conversationId}/stop, /pause and /resume: the control the gateway sent and the running threads of the conversation it sent it to. The gateway sends it as itself; the coordinator of each thread applies it as it would a person's control.

action.description: What was sent: stop_requested, thread_pause or thread_resume.

threads.description: The threads the control was sent to.
